fields.statement: Verifier at 3cb4a4ff5: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run 'TestCIStability|TestShipLocalGate' -v passes (TestCIStability, TestShipLocalGate, TestShipLocalGateOncePerHead). The cases cover: one TestX flake gives stable with reason 'TestX was seen once and ignored'; the same head twice gives stable; TestX and TestY once each give stable; TestX on 2 heads gives unstable with reason 'TestX flaked 2 times on 2 heads in the last 20 CI runs (stops applying after 16 more completed CI runs)', with N=2 for window 5, and stable after exactly N more clean runs but not N-1; infra-only gives stable with reason 'ignored infra failures: ...'; red main gives unstable with no flake and is cleared by a ship check main green record. Read the diff: the N formula window-(len-idx)+1 matches when the older of the two latest flaky heads leaves the window. ship_gate.go appends any stable verdict reason to 'CI is stable (...)', and the infra-only gate test checks that path, so a single-flake skip carries 'seen once and ignored'. ciVerdict takes its window from rhiza.ship.ciWindow through ciStabilityVerdict. gofmt and go vet on internal/api are clean.
